title: Club Membership: member discounts on ancillary services by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for every Club Membership tier, the member discount applied off the price of four ancillary services: personal-training packages, pro-shop store-credit top-ups, locker rental, and household add-on dues.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Personal training discount | Retail store-credit discount | Locker rental discount | Household add-on discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Student Metro Access | 5 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 0 percent | 0 percent | 5 percent | 0 percent |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 5 percent | 5 percent | 5 percent | 5 percent |
| Premier All-Access | 10 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent |
| Black Card All-Access | 15 percent | 15 percent | 20 percent | 15 percent |
| Founding Legacy Access | 10 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent |

## Reading the table
Each percentage in this table is a discount off that ancillary service's own listed price, applied independently of the other three columns; a tier showing 0 percent in a column carries no discount on that particular service.
